 Through: Mr. Sunil Kumar Gautam,

 Si Kusum, Ps Knk Marg.
 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Amit Mahajan
 Order

The petitioners seek quashing of FIR No.641/2013 dated 30.12.2013 under Sections 498A/406 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 registered at Police Station K.N. Katju Marg, on the ground that all the disputes have already been settled and the statement of the complainant in that regard was also recorded by the learned Mahila Court in the proceedings under Section 125 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.
4. The learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State accepts notice.

5. Notice to Respondent No. 2 be served through all permissible modes.
6. List on 20.01.2026.
AMIT MAHAJAN, J DECEMBER 1, 2025 "SK"

Katju Marg, on the ground that all the disputes have already been settled and the statement of the complainant in that regard was also recorded by the learned Mahila Court in the proceedings under Section 125 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.
2. Parties have also obtained divorce.
